definition: so = nên, chỉ kết quả; so that = để mà, chỉ mục đích.
example_en: It rained, so the game was canceled. / He left early so that he could catch the train.
explanation: so = nên, chỉ kết quả; so that = để mà, chỉ mục đích.
audio_text: It rained, so the game was canceled. / He left early so that he could catch the train.

definition: therefore = trạng từ nối “do đó”; because = liên từ “vì”.
example_en: The costs increased; therefore, we revised the budget. / We revised the budget because the costs increased.
explanation: therefore = trạng từ nối “do đó”; because = liên từ “vì”.
audio_text: The costs increased; therefore, we revised the budget. / We revised the budget because the costs increased.
